summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Returns Feature Enhancement. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests passed for both OLL admin and Vendor roles - all required elements verified including status cards, table columns, create return form with mandatory proof upload, item-level costing fields, and vendor confirm/reject dialogs.
passed_tests: GET /api/returns - OLL admin can fetch all returns
GET /api/returns - Vendor can fetch their own returns only
GET /api/returns?status=X - Status filter works correctly (sent, confirmed, rejected)
GET /api/purchase-orders?status=delivered - Returns delivered POs for return creation
POST /api/returns - Correctly rejects return without return_proof_url (validation)
POST /api/returns - Creates return with return_proof, original_price, deduction_amount, deduction_reason
POST /api/returns - Vendor correctly denied from creating returns (only OLL can)
POST /api/returns/{id}/confirm - Vendor confirms with credit_note_number and credit_note_url
POST /api/returns/{id}/confirm - Correctly requires credit note fields
POST /api/returns/{id}/confirm - OLL correctly denied from confirming (only vendors can)
POST /api/returns/{id}/reject - Vendor rejects with rejection_reason
POST /api/returns/{id}/reject - Correctly requires rejection_reason field
DELETE /api/returns/{id} - OLL can delete returns
DELETE /api/returns/{id} - Vendor correctly denied from deleting
Return status flow: sent -> confirmed works correctly
GET /api/returns - Correctly requires authentication
UI: OLL Returns List - status cards (Pending, Confirmed, Rejected, Total Credit)
UI: OLL Returns List - all table columns displayed (Return #, PO #, Vendor, Items, Credit Amount, Credit Note #, Status, Date, Actions)
UI: OLL Create Return Form - PO selection shows delivered POs only
UI: OLL Create Return Form - Return Proof (Mandatory) section with file upload
UI: OLL Create Return Form - Item fields: Original Price (per unit), Deduction Amount, Deduction Reason
UI: OLL Create Return Form - Save button disabled without proof upload
UI: Vendor Returns List - summary cards (Pending Review, Credit Notes Issued, Rejected)
UI: Vendor Returns List - Confirm and Reject buttons visible on pending returns
UI: Vendor Confirm Dialog - Credit Note Number input, Credit Note Upload field, Submit button disabled without data
UI: Vendor Reject Dialog - Rejection Reason textarea, Submit button disabled without reason
seed_data_creation: Used existing delivered POs (PO-002, PO-003) for return creation tests. Created test returns were cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Returns feature is fully functional with complete backend API coverage and UI verification. Key features working: mandatory return proof upload, item-level costing with original price from PO, deduction amounts with reasons, status tracking (sent/confirmed/rejected), vendor confirm flow with credit note upload, vendor reject flow with reason. The login button uses data-testid='login-btn' (not 'login-button').
